purpose: Post-exposure search-efficiency revision; preserve v3 curation tools and scientific gates
target_profile_order: descending existing IC50/type-B record count; skip targets already profiled; target counts are not compound counts
assay_decision_order: LLM reviews the ranked previews and chooses assay IDs; exact assay count before full retrieval when a count probe is useful
llm_authority: Choose target/assay, next tool, source interpretation, whether to inspect, count, retrieve, curate, hold, reject, or finish. Program supplies verified counts and numerical curation; model cannot override gates.
budget_interpretation: Old v3 attempts and tokens remain in the copied historical prefix. New total LLM ceiling is old attempts + 12; new HTTP ceiling is requests already used + 100.
prior_exposure: All DYRK3 and Task1 v1-v3 evidence/results have already been seen. This is an exploratory software/search extension, not a blind replication.
